name: Hotel & Restaurant Kaiserfels
beschreibung: The Hotel & Restaurant Kaiserfels is located in the center of St. Johann in Tirol, just a few minutes' walk from the pedestrian zone and the valley station of the Steinplatte. The hotel combines traditional Tiroler hospitality with modern comfort and offers brightly furnished rooms as well as a spacious wellness area. The in-house restaurant serves regional dishes. The proximity to the Kitzbüheler Alpen makes the hotel a suitable starting point for hikes and excursions.
